title: Retainer Billing Run
description: Retainer Billing Run v1.4.0 is a governance-first monthly billing workflow for RailCall Station v0.55. Its five-node legacy canvas remains compatible, while an eight-node engine_spec enables the DAG Runner, Studio Run Button and Context Form, plus MCP DAG list and plan. validate rejects malformed rows; dedup consistently removes duplicate and already-billed emails; plan_summary calculates counts and planned spend; an optional read-only anomaly advisory receives only anonymized batch metrics and never gates charge; charge uses the human-approved, idempotent stripe_billing_bill_client action with a deterministic period-based description; reconcile reports intended versus landed results. Station's native max_spend_cents policy and rollback remain the financial guardrails. Live Stripe and Groq provider completion on the tested Station v0.55 runtime is limited by the documented sandbox DNS hostname-to-IP enforcement issue; this listing does not claim live provider or provider-receipt success. Demo: https://youtu.be/RpGMJgPzEcw contest:2026Q3
desc: Governance-first monthly retainer billing with an opt-in anonymised anomaly advisory.

def is_valid_amount(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool): return False
    if not isinstance(v, int): return False
    return v > 0

billable = []
rejected = []
rows = input if isinstance(input, list) else []
for row in rows:
    if not isinstance(row, dict):
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "not_an_object"})
        continue
    email = row.get("email")
    amt = row.get("amount_cents")
    if not email:
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "missing_email"})
        continue
    if amt is None:
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "missing_amount"})
        continue
    if not is_valid_amount(amt):
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "invalid_amount"})
        continue
    billable.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt})
output = {"billable": billable, "rejected": rejected}

vo = input.get("validate_output") or {}
billable = vo.get("billable") or []
seen = set()
already = set(input.get("already_billed") or [])
period = str(input.get("period") or "").strip()
description = "Retainer billing for " + period if period else "Retainer billing"
clean = []
skipped = []
for row in billable:
    email = row.get("email")
    amt = row.get("amount_cents")
    if email in seen:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt, "reason": "duplicate_in_export"})
        continue
    seen.add(email)
    if email in already:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt, "reason": "already_billed_this_period"})
        continue
    clean.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt, "description": description, "period": period})
output = {"clean": clean, "skipped": skipped}

do = input.get("dedup_output") or {}
vo = input.get("validate_output") or {}
clean = do.get("clean") or []
skipped = do.get("skipped") or []
rejected = vo.get("rejected") or []
total_cents = sum(int(c.get("amount_cents") or 0) for c in clean)
ceiling = input.get("spend_ceiling_cents")
within_cap = isinstance(ceiling, int) and not isinstance(ceiling, bool) and total_cents <= ceiling
has_billable = len(clean) > 0
output = {
    "billable_count": len(clean),
    "skipped_count": len(skipped),
    "rejected_count": len(rejected),
    "total_cents": total_cents,
    "spend_ceiling_cents": ceiling,
    "within_cap": within_cap,
    "proceed": has_billable and within_cap,
}

vo = input.get("validate_output") or {}
billable = vo.get("billable") or []
already = set(x.strip() for x in (input.get("already_billed") or []) if isinstance(x, str) and x.strip())
seen = set()
clean = []
skipped = []
period = str(input.get("period") or "").strip()
description = "Retainer billing for " + period if period else "Retainer billing"
for row in billable:
    email = row.get("email")
    amount = row.get("amount_cents")
    if email in seen:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "reason": "duplicate_in_export"})
        continue
    seen.add(email)
    if email in already:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "reason": "already_billed_this_period"})
        continue
    clean.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "description": description, "period": period})
output = {"clean": clean, "skipped": skipped}

value = str(input or "").strip().lower()
output = {"enabled": value in ("1", "true", "yes", "on") }
